descriptions.value: 生命之树被烧毁后，世间陷入一片混沌。为拯救苍生，孙悟空决定回到过去，帮助生命之树复活。因为失去了金箍棒，孙悟空力量时有时无，只得找回儿时的自己，一同前往寻找时间之力。不料，六耳猕猴却想据为己有，两人就此爆发激战。

titles.value: 我爱罗兰度 / I Love Lolanto

descriptions.value: Lolanto自命风流，一次因伤入院结识了富商的弱智独生女儿阿蚊，她如小孩般天真可爱，渐渐更与Lolanto成为好友。蚊父因此聘请Lolanto来照顾她。不久，蚊入院做智力恢复手术，但恢复智力后的阿蚊与Lolanto建立的情谊却黯然离去…

descriptions.value: 故事描述一对表姐妹梁山伯与祝英台乃斗气冤家，两女为争夺神秘俊男阿山欢心，却惹来大圈杀手威吓逼害，更陷入一场宝物争夺战。两女身陷险境，惟有摒弃前嫌，连手反抗……

descriptions.value: 十八年前，邪恶的黑羽会潜入了老邪神西城勇的地盘，盗走了修罗面具，而利用修罗面具放出当时只是个婴儿的魔神。老邪神为了魔神日后不作恶收养了婴儿，教他好好做人，成为小邪神。小邪神最后控制了面具的力量成为老邪神的接班人，继续守护城市。

descriptions.value: 「神龙教」教主龙儿奉命协助吴三桂推翻康熙皇帝，却反遭吴三桂陷害，幸得韦小宝相救才得以保命。于是龙儿以身相许，并把绝世武功传于韦小宝以对付吴三桂。最后，韦小宝更意外地从四十二章经中得知满清龙脉的秘密宝藏。

titles.value: 风流冤鬼 / Sex Beyond The Grave

descriptions.value: 红歌女阿花遭大户陶老爷奸杀，陶宅即常闹鬼，后陶老爷亦神秘死亡。陶之后人陶明嗜赌如命，更因鬼魂作怪而欠下巨款。明妻暗中将陶宅售予杨教授夫妇，即遇上怪事连篇...

titles.value: 逃学威龙 / Fight Back to School

descriptions.value: 飞虎队精英周星星奉命潜入校园，调查一宗警枪失窃案。在拍档达叔的协助下，他不仅成功寻回失枪，更意外揭发一宗大型地下军火交易。走私集团为报复，悍然持械闯入学校，挟持多名学生作为人质。周星星必须不惜一切代价，拯救所有人质。
骄横军阀侯杰在惨遭亲信曹蛮残酷背叛、痛失至爱幼女后，心灰意冷下大彻大悟投身少林隐姓埋名。不料野心勃勃的叛将曹蛮紧随其后引兵屠城，使千年古刹少林危在旦夕。已皈依佛门的侯杰重拾昔日信念，在这场充满血色的因果轮回中，誓以血肉之躯筑起最后的救赎。
曾经叱咤世界拳坛的拳王程辉，在澳门遇见了热血青年思齐。随着他训练思齐备战即将举行的混合格斗赛，程辉不仅重燃了对拳击的热爱，还重新找回了对生命的热情，并更加珍惜那些在生命中真正重要的人。
台湾女孩阿不前往香港，寻找漂流玻璃樽中那封浪漫纸条的作者阿拔。谁料现实阿拔与幻想的相差甚远，让她心碎失望、决定黯然返乡。就在命运的转角，她遇上富豪企业家陈子午，就此展开一段意想不到的爱情故事。

titles.value: 青蛇：前缘 / The Fate of Reunion

descriptions.value: 千年前，青蛇在道清的点化下逐渐开化，生出与道清相守之心。因自己对道清的执念，却导致道清进入轮回之劫，遭受世间横死之难。为了化解道清的劫难，数百年间，青蛇不断寻找转世的道清…

titles.value: 表错七日情 / Let's Make Laugh

descriptions.value: 一对年轻夫妇因欠税款被法庭下令封屋，限七日缴付欠税，并以房屋和财产作为抵偿。丈夫因移情别恋不知去向，法庭则雇用一个年轻的护卫员来看管少妇。那护卫员竟然与少妇日久生情…

titles.value: 反收数特遣队 / Shark Busters

descriptions.value: 在金融危机期间，绝大多数香港市民陷入债务困境。此时，贵利集团采取无情手段逼迫债务人还款，李探员与其地下部队誓言缉拿这个非法组织的头目。

titles.value: 南北妈打 / Mother VS Mother

descriptions.value: 关德兴年青时与李消云相恋，遭母亲反对，只好和周申玉结婚。关的儿子关仁坚工作上认识了文文。申玉发现儿子追求的女友文文，竟是消云的女儿。两个妈打情敌又一次碰头，再斗个你死我活。

titles.value: 武状元苏乞儿 / King Of Beggars

descriptions.value: 苏乞儿原为贵族，但因上京考武状元时作弊，被眨为乞儿。苏乞儿在机缘巧合下救了丐帮长老，并接任为新帮主。一天，皇上狩猎之时，差点被暗杀，幸苏乞儿及时救驾。皇帝欲恢复其官职时，苏乞儿却拒绝。其后，皇上御赐一个乞儿钵予苏乞儿，从此他过着愉快的行乞生活。
东北某小城，一家麻辣汤馆每天都迎来不同的客人。这些客人中有如胶似漆的小情侣，两名放荡不羁的青年和一位的士司机。他们本是毫无交集的人，却因为一场交通事故牵扯在一起…
城中著名的「盗贼三人组」受聘以3000万元绑架一名婴孩。当他们发现黑帮不仅企图吞掉赎金，更要置婴孩于死地后，决定担起保护婴孩的责任，并护送他平安回家。一方面要躲避警方追捕，另一方面又遭黑帮穷追不舍，三人即使危机四伏，仍誓死守护婴孩。

titles.value: 龙的传人 / Legend Of The Dragon

descriptions.value: 青年周小龙离开纯朴的离岛到香港发展。他的师叔欺骗小龙参加桌球比赛，并以他父亲的地皮作为赌注。小龙最后输掉了比赛，幸得他青梅竹马的朋友毛毛鼓励，把自家的田地也作为赌注。小龙最后能否把自己的土地赢回来？

titles.value: China's ocean economy at a turning point

descriptions.value:
Since elevating the goal of becoming a "maritime power" in 2012, China has made significant progress. What are the most eye-catching achievements? As the focus shifts from speed to quality, how could China's AI and digital tech edge help reshape the country's traditional maritime sectors? And in a system where a few countries still hold technological and narrative dominance, how can China gain a greater voice in rule-setting through global cooperation?

Host TU Yun joins Yan Yan, a senior research fellow with the National Institute for South China Sea Studies, Qu Qiang, a professor and fellow of the Belt and Road Research Center at Minzu University of China, and Warwick Powell, an adjunct professor at Queensland University of Technology, to navigate the opportunities, challenges, and what lies beneath the surface.

titles.value: The secret of the 'Long Hair' village

descriptions.value: For the Red Yao women of Guangxi, southern China, hair is far more than a mark of beauty – it's a living narrative of identity, lineage, and nature. Each stage of life is reflected in how they wear it, carrying the memory of their families and the wisdom of their ancestors. Their time-honored rice-water hair care ritual is not just a beauty secret – it's a thread connecting generations, preserving ecological knowledge passed down through centuries. Join CGTN host Julian Waghann and Filipina singer Eliza Arce as they step into Huangluo Yao Village, known as the "World's Longest Hair Village," to uncover the stories and traditions behind the Red Yao's legendary long hair.

In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May venture to Qingdao, China's beer mecca by the sea. With red tiles and green trees that make up the city's stunning scenery, our hosts embark on another foodie-journey with local delicacies and interesting guest appearances. From drinking beer with a German friend, catching crabs by the ocean and devouring grilled eel the classic Korean way, this episode will leave you hungry for more!

In Yongchun, China, Kleber explores the origins of White Crane kungfu and its effect on the martial arts world. He learns how its blocks and strikes were inspired by animal movements, and how acupuncture points can be used to deadly effect. After training his grip and finger strength with wooden sticks, he travels to Beijing for an introduction to Goju-ryu karate, and discovers striking similarities with White Crane.

Join us in Nanjing's bustling old quarter, where you can try on silk dresses worth their weight in gold, and see how traditional handicrafts have been given modern twists. We'll feast on street snacks and local delicacies by the old Confucian Temple, before taking a pleasure cruise along Nanjing's mother river to round off our exploration of this vibrant and historic city.

This episode explores not only their surrounding landscapes, design concepts, architectural styles and interior furnishings, but also the distinctive natural scenery and profound local cultural features of each region.

titles.value: Kung Fu Wise II-1 Baji Quan

descriptions.value:
In the first episode of Season 2 of Kung Fu Wise, Baji Quan, host Kleber travels to Mengcun, Cangzhou, in Hebei Province. There, he meets Wu Hao, the young head of the Wu-style Baji Quan school. Together, they journey across the North China Plain, from bustling village markets and the family training hall to the Bohai Sea coast, as Kleber experiences Baji Quan’s explosive power first-hand.
Along the way, the episode unpacks the idea of “opening the gate”, the key to focused power, and the spirit of spear work. It goes beyond technique to reveal Cangzhou’s rich martial heritage, tracing how Wu-style Baji Quan has travelled from its hometown to Europe, proof that traditional kung fu can endure, evolve, and thrive today. In the end, Wu Hao answers with action: true inheritance is not only about skills, but about shaping spirit and character.

Lhasa, set high on the “Roof of the World” in China’s southwest, is both the capital of Xizang Autonomous Region, and the spiritual heart of Tibetan culture. In this episode, host Tianran He ventures deep into the fabled Potala Palace, discovering ancient meditation caves, priceless relics and golden rooftops. Then, he tries his hand at Tibetan papermaking, learning how a poisonous ingredient is crucial for making paper that can survive for centuries. Finally, Tianran dons his apron and learns to make iconic Tibetan dishes, including one said to reveal your fortune!
